title: Evolution & scientific inquiry
goal: Ask testable questions and connect evidence, evolution, and biological organization.

title: Atoms, bonds & chemistry
goal: Relate atomic structure and bonding to the behavior of matter.

title: Water & life's chemistry
goal: Explain how water's polarity produces life-supporting properties.

title: Carbon & molecular diversity
goal: Connect carbon skeletons and functional groups to molecular properties.

title: Biological macromolecules
goal: Relate molecular structure to the functions of proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, and nucleic acids.

title: Inside the cell
goal: Trace how cell compartments and the cytoskeleton cooperate.

title: Membranes & transport
goal: Predict movement of water and solutes across selective membranes.

title: Energy, enzymes & metabolism
goal: Use energy changes and enzyme behavior to explain metabolic control.

title: Respiration & fermentation
goal: Follow carbon, electrons, and protons during ATP production.

title: Photosynthesis
goal: Connect light capture, electron flow, and carbon fixation.

title: Cell signals & responses
goal: Trace reception, transduction, amplification, and cellular responses.

title: The cell cycle
goal: Explain chromosome movement and the control of cell division.

title: Meiosis & sexual life cycles
goal: Distinguish chromosome number from DNA amount and explain genetic reshuffling.

title: Mendelian inheritance
goal: Use probability and inheritance models to explain offspring variation.

title: Chromosomes & inheritance
goal: Connect chromosome behavior to linkage and inheritance patterns.

title: DNA replication & repair
goal: Explain how DNA structure enables copying and repair.

title: From genes to proteins
goal: Translate between nucleotide sequences, RNA processing, and proteins.

title: Regulating gene expression
goal: Explain how cells regulate gene activity without changing every gene.

title: Viruses & infectious particles
goal: Compare viral replication strategies and dependence on host cells.

title: DNA tools & biotechnology
goal: Choose and interpret tools for changing, amplifying, and analyzing DNA.

title: Genomes & their evolution
goal: Relate genome organization, duplication, and comparative sequence data.

title: Evolution by natural selection
goal: Distinguish selection acting on individuals from populations evolving.

title: Evolution in populations
goal: Use allele frequencies to compare selection, drift, and gene flow.

title: How species arise
goal: Explain reproductive isolation and alternative routes to speciation.

title: Life through deep time
goal: Connect fossils, environmental change, and major transitions in life.

title: Phylogeny & classification
goal: Read evolutionary trees using shared ancestry and character evidence.

title: Bacteria & archaea
goal: Connect prokaryotic structure, metabolism, and genetic exchange.

title: Protists & eukaryotic origins
goal: Explain endosymbiosis and the diversity of eukaryotic microbial lineages.

title: Plants colonize land
goal: Trace the innovations and life cycles of nonvascular and seedless plants.

title: Seeds, flowers & plant diversity
goal: Explain how seeds and pollen changed plant reproduction and dispersal.

title: Fungi
goal: Connect fungal feeding, life cycles, and symbioses.

title: Animal body plans
goal: Relate animal development and symmetry to major evolutionary branches.

title: Invertebrate diversity
goal: Compare the structures and functions of major invertebrate groups.

title: Vertebrate evolution
goal: Relate chordate traits and vertebrate innovations to common ancestry.

title: Plant structure & growth
goal: Connect plant tissues, meristems, and growth patterns.

title: Transport in plants
goal: Explain water potential, transpiration, and source-to-sink transport.

title: Soil & plant nutrition
goal: Connect mineral uptake, soil properties, and root symbioses.

title: Flowering plant reproduction
goal: Trace pollination, double fertilization, seed development, and propagation.

title: Plant signals & defenses
goal: Predict growth and defense responses to light, hormones, and stress.

title: Animal tissues & homeostasis
goal: Relate body organization and feedback to regulated internal conditions.

title: Digestion & nutrition
goal: Follow food processing and absorption through the digestive system.

title: Circulation & gas exchange
goal: Connect pressure, flow, diffusion, and respiratory gas transport.

title: Immunity
goal: Compare innate defenses, adaptive specificity, and immune memory.

title: Water balance & excretion
goal: Relate nephron transport to water conservation and waste removal.

title: Hormones & endocrine control
goal: Trace endocrine feedback and explain target-cell specificity.

title: Animal reproduction
goal: Connect reproductive anatomy, gamete production, and hormonal cycles.

title: Animal development
goal: Explain how cell movements, signaling, and gene activity build an embryo.

title: Neurons & synapses
goal: Predict electrical and chemical signaling from ion gradients and channel states.

title: Nervous systems & the brain
goal: Connect neural organization to integration, behavior, and memory.

title: Senses & movement
goal: Trace sensory transduction and the mechanics of muscle contraction.

title: Animal behavior
goal: Connect behavioral mechanisms, learning, and reproductive success.

title: Ecology & the biosphere
goal: Connect climate, distribution, and the physical structure of biomes.

title: Population ecology
goal: Model population change using demography and density dependence.

title: Communities & interactions
goal: Explain how interactions and disturbance shape communities.

title: Ecosystems & nutrient cycles
goal: Track energy flow and matter cycling through ecosystems.

title: Conservation & global change
goal: Evaluate threats to biodiversity and evidence for conservation decisions.
